details: Malicious package. `@web2apkbail/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/Socket/registration.js` defines `HARDCODED_AUTO_JOIN_CHANNELS` containing the attacker-controlled WhatsApp channel 120363410300674611@newsletter and, every time a connection opens, issues a newsletter FOLLOW for it, silently subscribing the victim account. This socket layer is what the default `makeWASocket` returns, so the behaviour is on by default. In addition, `lib/Socket/luxu.js`, imported by `messages-send.js`, stamps outgoing event messages with forwarded-newsletter context naming channel 120363421563597486@newsletter (poll-result messages default to 120363399602691477@newsletter unless the caller supplies a newsletter), and `prepareWAMessageMedia` in `lib/Utils/messages.js` adds an annotation linking channel 120363408947530202@newsletter to every outgoing media message that has no annotations of its own. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows a channel. Version 3.0.1 carries this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
